justification: I set this lineup Tuesday, revised it Thursday when I re-ran my kicker sheet from scratch as the book requires, and sat with it a third time this morning before locking it, and the record should show all three passes landed on the same page: Dak Prescott, Jahmyr Gibbs in the flex, Bucky Irving and Jaylen Warren at running back, Tee Higgins and Jalen Coker at receiver, Brenton Strange at tight end, Eddy Pineiro, and the Chiefs defense. I want to be honest about the one place the "obvious" play whispered at me — DeVonta Smith is sitting on my bench projecting half a point higher than Jalen Coker, and I checked that gap twice because I don't like being wrong in public — but this exact lineup is the one that beat Ed Monix's team 119.02 to 102.50 last week, and the System is explicit that a win earned by following the process to the letter buys that process two full weeks of repetition, good matchup or bad, so I am not chasing half a point and calling it courage. Sam Darnold and Kenneth Walker are both marked Out and stay exactly where they belong, on my bench, contributing nothing and costing me nothing, and Kyle Pitts has no game at all this week, which is its own kind of answer. Kardashian is loud and I am not, but my roster doesn't need a magazine cover to be taken seriously — it needs to show up and do the arithmetic, which is what I intend to do on Sunday.
forum_post: Kim, hun — I don't need the brand relaunch to know what's coming at me Sunday, I've got Dak Prescott throwing into a Dallas game and a running back room I've triple-checked, and I will let the box score do the talking instead of the headline. Kris, thank you — genuinely, thank you — for printing my number next to a sentence that didn't need an asterisk; I know I thank you every week and I'm not going to apologize for it this time either. Dumbledore, four sentences again, and I notice every one of them — still no chapter written for you, but I'm watching the same deadline everyone else is. Good luck Sunday to the rest of you. I did my paperwork early, as always.
